entries.finding: The intake path normalizes every open issue into a repository-mutating atom contract or blocks it, so a non-actionable caveat or a disclosed-not-fixed finding cannot exist as an issue; across wave 9 every such item degraded into prose on a record that then closed, and three lanes independently rediscovered the same hole.
receipts: noodles.py:intake_normalize - every open issue read by `.noodle/adapters/github sync` is PATCHed into the atom contract or blocked with an intake comment
ed3c/noodles#263 body - the wave-9 clause-compliance judge's rank-1 gap, S2, that filed this register

entries.finding: The one physical instance behind the staged-transition rule - PR ed3c/noodles#129 could not go green because trusted verify runs main's copy of a test over the candidate tree - is recorded only inside the bodies of ed3c/noodles#252 and ed3c/noodles#253; when those close, the rule in contracts/system-v1.md keeps its statement and loses its evidence.
receipts: ed3c/noodles#252 body - PR ed3c/noodles#129 verify run 33366751879, job `Run trusted positive and planted-negative controls`, failure at .trusted/tests/test_noodles.py:298
.github/workflows/verify.yml - PYTHONPATH .trusted with NOODLES_CANDIDATE_ROOT .candidate is why main's copy judges the candidate
contracts/system-v1.md staged-transition paragraph - states the rule with no receipt attached

entries.finding: `./noodles issue handoff` carries the journey-compilation gate but the merge-gating verify path never calls it, and real lanes reach awaiting_land by flipping the state marker directly, so the gate landed by ed3c/noodles#242 is enforced only on a route those lanes physically cannot take.
receipts: noodles.py:execute_handoff is the only caller of feature_contract.compile_handoff_feature_map
merged PRs fix-46-worktree-admission, fix-99-exclusive-admission, fix-100-concurrency-invariants - none uses the ed3c-noodles-N-0-execute branch that noodles.execute_provenance_admission requires
